```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(rstatix)
  library(ggpubr)
})
freq_rds <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/motif_analysis_no_annot/endmotif_4bp_freq_per_sample_ATGC_only.rds"

meta_single_csv <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/metastasis_site_summary/metastasis_single_site_combinations.csv"

outdir <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/cfDNA_project/Broad/NST/End_motif/diversity_50"
dir.create(outdir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

top_sites <- c("brain", "bone", "liver")
TOP_K <- 50

```

```{r}
df_freq <- readRDS(freq_rds)

meta_single <- read_csv(meta_single_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    id = str_trim(id),
    metastatic_sites = str_to_lower(str_trim(metastatic_sites))
  ) %>%
  filter(metastatic_sites %in% top_sites)

```

```{r}
df_site <- df_freq %>%
  inner_join(meta_single, by = "id") %>%
  mutate(
    metastatic_sites = factor(metastatic_sites, levels = top_sites),
    end_motif = toupper(str_trim(end_motif))
  ) %>%
  filter(!grepl("[^ATGC]", end_motif)) %>%     # ATGC-only
  filter(is.finite(freq.corrected))            # drop NA / Inf
df_site %>%
  distinct(id, metastatic_sites) %>%
  count(metastatic_sites)

```
```{r}
shannon_entropy <- function(p) {
  p <- p[p > 0]
  -sum(p * log(p))
}
```


```{r}
div50_df <- df_site %>%
  group_by(id, metastatic_sites) %>%
  arrange(desc(freq.corrected), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n = TOP_K) %>%                     # top 50 motifs
  summarise(
    diversity_50 = shannon_entropy(freq.corrected / sum(freq.corrected)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

```{r}
write_csv(div50_df, file.path(outdir, "diversity50_per_sample.csv"))

# Global test (KW)
res_kw <- kruskal_test(div50_df, diversity_50 ~ metastatic_sites)
res_kw

# Pairwise Wilcoxon
res_pairwise <- div50_df %>%
  wilcox_test(diversity_50 ~ metastatic_sites) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "BH") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj")

write_csv(res_pairwise, file.path(outdir, "diversity50_pairwise_wilcox.csv"))

```
```{r}
site_cols <- c(
  brain = "#4DBBD5",
  bone  = "#E64B35",
  liver = "#00A087"
)

p <- ggplot(div50_df,
            aes(x = metastatic_sites,
                y = diversity_50,
                fill = metastatic_sites)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.85) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1.2, alpha = 0.6, color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = site_cols) +
  labs(
    x = "Metastatic site (single-site only)",
    y = "Diversity-50 (Shannon entropy)",
    title = "cfDNA end-motif diversity across metastatic sites",
    subtitle = "Shannon entropy of top 50 most abundant 4-mer end motifs"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Add global KW p-value
p <- p + annotate(
  "text",
  x = 2,
  y = max(div50_df$diversity_50) * 1.05,
  label = paste0("KW p = ", signif(res_kw$p, 3)),
  size = 4
)

print(p)

```
```{r}
ggsave(file.path(outdir, "boxplot_diversity50_by_site.png"),
       p, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)

ggsave(file.path(outdir, "boxplot_diversity50_by_site.pdf"),
       p, width = 7, height = 5)

```
